review.headline: Easy 9 km completed at 5:50/km, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band and close to the previous easy run.
observations: Distance 9.01 km against 9.0 planned, moving time 3150 s, no laps or HR data recorded.
Every km split was exactly 350 s (5:50/km), a very even, controlled pace consistent with relaxed running.
Pace is 8 s/km slower than the 11-05 easy run (5:42/km), and the 4-week easy average is 5:46/km, so this sits in the normal easy range.
flags: No heart rate, RPE or cadence was logged, so effort cannot be confirmed against the conversational intent.
Weekly volume is far behind plan (26 of 42 km in week 1 and only 6.5 km/week 4-week average), with CTL down 5.0 over 7 days.
